senses.gloss: pr. n.M’zag (Mizgag), eponymous hero of a tribe answering to Mazices, Mazyes (Maxyes) in Northern Africa (v. Sm. Greek a. Roman Geogr. s. v. Mauretania).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 10:7">Targ. Y. Gen. X, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 1:9">Targ. I Chr. I, 9</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>מזגג</he>); <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 1:32">ib. 32</cite> (h. text <he>דדן</he>).
